description: Request for a single page of CurationTasks with optional filtering.

projectId.description: Optional. The synId of the project. If omitted, results are aggregated across projects.

assigneeIds.description: Optional. Filter tasks assigned to specific users or teams.

assignedToMe.description: Optional. When true, filter to tasks assigned to the caller or any team the caller belongs to. Cannot be combined with assigneeIds.

stateFilter.description: Optional. Filter tasks by their current state.

nextPageToken.description: Forward the returned 'nextPageToken' to get the next page of results.
